goal: Applying a control command appends a steering domain event to the ledger and deletes the applied queue row, and released or expired task claims leave no rows behind.

constraints: Spec FR-10 is authoritative: the domain event records kind, payload, and applied-at; it is appended AFTER the live SDK action succeeds; the queue row is deleted only after the event commits, and on event-append failure the row is retained so the failure is visible
The new DomainEventKind must be handled by the replay fold (a recorded, state-neutral entry) without weakening lifecycle purity tests
Claim rows are deleted on release and on steal of an expired lease; completed tasks leave zero task_claims rows
The steering event reaches the run JSONL automatically via the existing domain-mirror path -- do not add a second mirror
Update every test that asserts claimed control_commands rows persist after apply, in the same commit
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No new control-command verbs and no changes to claim-once semantics
edge_cases: A command claimed but whose SDK application fails: no domain event, row already claimed -- decide and test the visible outcome rather than leaving it undefined
Watcher restart between claim and event append must not double-apply or double-record
